verdict.rationale: Carta publishes a documented public API platform with OAuth 2.0 authorization, a developer portal, playground/sandbox environment, Postman guide, and extensive REST endpoint reference docs covering cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, and FMVs. Missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s), and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
